title: REQ · BootScene syncs objects with the store and forwards clicks to React
summary: State changes call sync on each SceneObject and object activation emits objectClick
description: Context: SceneObject.sync applies visibleWhen and onInteract reports activations; BootScene.onStateChange currently only reads state. Desired behavior: after building, BootScene syncs every object with the current state and on each store change, and emits phaserToReact objectClick with the object id on activation. Expected result: persistent object state (e.g. secret door) shows after changes. Why: React and Phaser stay consistent without duplicate state.
acceptance_criteria: Given a non-null store state, when create runs, then sync(state) is called on each built object
Given a store change to a new state, when onStateChange runs, then sync(newState) is called on each object
Given a null state, when onStateChange runs, then no sync is called
Given an object's onInteract callback, when invoked with objectId, then phaserToReact.emit('objectClick', {id}) is called
technical_constraints: No GameState copy kept in BootScene
definition_of_done: Objects reflect store state and clicks reach the bus
